verdict.rationale: LocalAI's built-in web interface covers chatting and managing installations (docs-20), and models can be installed from the gallery Discover page or listed via the CLI (docs-6, docs-7), so downloaded-model management in one place is documented. Per-model configuration is only glimpsed through model aliasing and /models/apply-style preload parameters (docs-13, docs-12). Saved prompts are not evidenced: the only mention is editing saved chat messages, which is chat history rather than a prompt library. missing for 10: a saved-prompt or prompt-library feature, a documented per-model configuration editor in the same UI, evidence that models, prompts, and configs are managed together in one place, independent or hands-on corroboration.
